articles.title: Bitcoin stuck below $65,000 as Hormuz hopes evaporate, XRP close to dropping below $1
articles.snippet: The Strait of Hormuz relief trade unraveled after Trump demanded 50 years of Iranian compensation, pushing oil back to $89 and leaving crypto and equities unchanged ahead of a pivotal CPI report.

articles.title: Trump Media’s bitcoin holdings shrink as crypto losses hit $361 million
articles.snippet: The Truth Social parent held 9,477 BTC worth $557 million at the end of June, while its Cronos position also suffered a steep drop in value.

articles.title: White House vows to get CLARITY across ‘finish line’ in September
articles.snippet: Patrick Witt says the Trump administration will keep negotiating with Democrats as the Senate prepares for a September CLARITY vote.

articles.title: Trump Media to revamp crypto treasury strategy after $238M Q2 loss
articles.snippet: Trump Media says it will take a more disciplined approach to its crypto treasury while directing more resources toward its core media business.

articles.title: UK money laundering suspect bought $100M in Trump crypto business: NYT
articles.snippet: An individual behind the Aqua 1 entity that purchased $100 million worth of World Liberty Financial tokens in 2025 is reportedly a businessman with ties to the UK and UAE.
